verdict.rationale: Exporting data is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents an OAuth-authenticated REST API with a public OpenAPI spec, but that is only a developer building block. No documented bulk export, data portability feature, or open-format download appears; the only migration evidence covers importing legacy files into Harbor and transitioning to it, not leaving it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
